description: This file defines a servlet class 'AddFeedback' that handles HTTP POST requests to add user feedback, including comments and ratings, and interacts with a database utility to insert feedback data.

classes.name: AddFeedback
classes.description: A servlet class to handle user feedback submission, validate input, interact with database utility, and redirect or forward based on success.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to process feedback comments and ratings, validate inputs, insert feedback into database, and redirect or forward accordingly.
